facts.fact: The Réseau des Femmes Leaders pour le Développement (RFLD) held a three-day West Africa Feminist Data Summit in Porto-Novo on 28-30 July 2026, per its own report, with about 100 delegates including researchers, where tracks on censorship and shutdowns, TFGBV and decolonising data and AI each produced a policy brief on a legislative or regulatory gap.
